name: What should I do first when starting foreclosed property preparation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first when starting foreclosed property preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The very first step in preparing a foreclosed property is a comprehensive assessment of its current condition. This includes inspecting for structural issues, water damage, electrical or plumbing problems, and general wear and tear. Following the assessment, create a detailed scope of work and budget. Debris removal and initial cleaning often come next, paving the way for repairs and renovations. Engaging a professional contractor early can streamline this initial planning and execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, conduct a comprehensive assessment of the property's condition, then develop a scope of work and budget, followed by debris removal and initial cleaning.
